title: FIN-07 Behaviour batch transaction v1
description: One unlabeled transaction row for the local Behaviour ML batch PoC. CSV columns use the same property names. Labels are intentionally forbidden.

transaction_id.description: Stable source-system idempotency key. When absent, the loader derives a deterministic SHA-256 prefix from the normalized row.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 event time with an explicit timezone.

amount.description: Positive decimal string in payment currency; at most two decimal places.
